answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potentials to be used for question answering

answer_2.quote: We compute Hits@1 to evaluate the models' answers following prior works

answer_3.quote: we use GPT-3.5 to assess whether it is supported by the corresponding citation

answer_4.quote: We perform two human annotation experiments to evaluate the quality of: (i) final answer generated by the model ( §4.2.2) and (ii) web quotes extracted by our adaptive retriever ( §4.3)
answer_4.guideline: Each model output receives one of three labels: IDK (Does not know or is unable to answer), Incorrect (Is fully or partially incorrect), or Correct (Is fully correct with, possibly, extra information)
